request: The iterator package's replace operation returns a sequence that can be iterated any number of times with the same result: with a limit n it replaces the first n matches on every iteration, n < 0 replaces all matches and n == 0 replaces none.

defects.description: Published bug fixed upstream: fix: reset n counter per iteration in it.Replace (#799)
defects.why_missed: The project's own suite at the parent commit never exercised this input; the fix commit added the test that does.
